reddit.detail: RETIRED 2026-07-20. Reddit blocks unauthenticated JSON: old.reddit.com 403 and www.reddit.com 403, tested live with a browser User-Agent. No REDDIT_CLIENT_ID exists anywhere in the repo, so no request this system can make will succeed. The endpoint fix in 9bc2849 (old.reddit + raw_json=1) was correct code against a door that is shut. Reviving this source requires a registered OAuth app and oauth.reddit.com — not a code change here.

Macro backdrop —

  Inflation: CPI 3.05% YoY | core CPI 2.22% | core PCE 2.92% (Fed target 2%)

  Consumer: UMich sentiment 55.2 | VIX 14.81

---
Recent market action in the ES/NQ correlated pair has been characterized by a narrow, tech/AI-driven move. The NQ futures have shown a lead-lag regime that is currently classified as 'CONCENTRATION', with the NQ leading and pulling away from ES. This suggests a fragile directional bias, particularly in the tech-heavy sectors represented by the Nasdaq-100 (NQ). Given the current lead-lag dynamics, we should be cautious about trusting directional moves too heavily and watch for potential reversals when AI-related stocks cool off. The volume profile indicates that key support levels are around 7687.79 for ES and 29661.93 for NQ, with the point of convergence (POC) at 7706.58 for ES and 29738.02 for NQ. These areas represent accumulation zones where buying interest is likely to be concentrated. The event calendar highlights upcoming releases such as PCE on 2026-09-30, ISM Manufacturing PMI on 2026-10-01, Nonfarm Payrolls on 2026-10-02, and CPI on 2026-10-12. These events suggest that we should reduce our position size into the windows around these releases to manage risk effectively. Overall, the meta-regime is CONCENTRATION with a narrow probability bias of ~75%, invalidated below 30,375 for NQ.
